purpose: Read-only firmware rollout decision support from matched target/peer observation windows; explicitly not deployment control.
primaryGoal: Understand target regression, peer regression, matched excess, decision rationale and the evidence limitations before interpreting rollout readiness.

dataSources.behavior: Positive vehicle ID enables the query. Key includes vehicle, limit and offset; queryFn forwards AbortSignal; inherited query policy is unchanged. Snake_case response mirrors FirmwareCanary and AdvancedPage types. Service reads FirmwareWindow and currently constructs zero or one decision, then paginates that list; historical multi-row capabilities are not established.
dataSources.sourceEvidence: BuildFirmwareCanary names software_updates installation evidence and drives evidence; repository SQL, matching quality and actual production payloads were not exercised.

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect useVehicles; exact vehicle endpoint implementation not inspected in this bounded audit.
dataSources.ownership: Existing workspace vehicle store and URL synchronization.
dataSources.behavior: Page consumes the shell selection; URL > persisted valid ID > first loaded vehicle. workspaceScope.ts enables vehicle control and does not enable range for this exact route. Page has no competing local picker/date control.

dataSources.ownership: Existing shared number formatting hook; internal settings graph not inspected.
dataSources.behavior: Percentages are display-formatted without changing raw dimensionless percentage payloads. No physical-unit converter or backend mutation is introduced.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page decision article and EvidencePanel source cards (EvidencePanel.tsx:81) both hand-author fixed-white bordered surfaces instead of consuming the existing surface contract.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing neutral Card/surface tokens without new wrapper vocabulary; preserve article/heading semantics.

Pagination.tsx:50-52 uses min-w-0, wrapping and a named container; :47 reserves 44px mobile buttons; direct jump remains available.
risks: Long firmware version/source/summary strings need actual narrow-container and 200%-text review; source classes alone do not prove absence of overflow.

sourceBehavior: FirmwareCanaryPage.tsx:74 and :47 mark decorative icons aria-hidden; :75 uses Text as h3.
EvidencePanel.tsx:46,73,105 gives the three sections localized accessible labels and visible headings.
Pagination.tsx:50 names navigation; :54 announces range; :77-110 gives button names/current-page semantics; :132-136 labels jump input and associates validation error.
Decision and quality badges retain text, not color-only status.

issues.detail: Decision badge renders raw wire enum item.decision; EvidencePanel.tsx:55 likewise renders raw quality.status. These are presentation statuses rather than localized labels.
issues.fix: Translate known decision/quality enum labels with existing i18n conventions while preserving raw enum keys and decisionVariant mappings; retain a safe unknown fallback.

accessibility.runtimeStatus: Keyboard, focus, screen reader, target spacing, effective contrast, forced colors and reduced motion UNVERIFIED.

states.loading: Decision query passes through InsightPanel.tsx:38-43 to SourceContent loading skeleton. EvidencePanel has no query and can render unsupported/empty claims while the decision source is still loading.
states.empty: Successful items=[] gives vehicle-specific no-window message; no selected vehicle gives selection prerequisite. Evidence subsections remain present.
states.fatalError: InsightPanel uses fatalError and shared ErrorDisplay/retry; unrelated warning remains mounted.
states.retainedRefreshError: InsightPanel routes stale data to retained presentation; SourceContent.tsx:58-73 retains children and adds retry. EvidencePanel is outside that trust boundary.
states.offline: Initial paused query receives explicit unresolved/paused copy in InsightPanel.tsx:44-49. Retained paused source uses shared generic retained warning. No production offline case exercised.
states.unknownAndZero: Null target/peer/excess values remain null for StatCard placeholder; measured zero formats as 0. Percentage inputs are not physical-unit conversion candidates.

issues.detail: EvidencePanel receives only latest item fields (:134-136), not the source query/trust state. Its InsightPanel has no query (EvidencePanel.tsx:38), so initial loading/failure/no selection is presented as quality unsupported, no evidence returned and no additional limitations. Retained evidence also lacks its own visible stale/offline context.
issues.fix: Pass the existing query/trust and prerequisite state into the domain EvidencePanel adapter; retain its shell/subsections and explicit unsupported capabilities. Show unresolved/loading/error separately from authoritative successful missing metadata, and keep retained evidence on refresh failure with recovery.

visualIssues.detail: Decision surface uses border-white/[0.08] and bg-white/[0.025]; rationale at :102 uses border-white/[0.06]. EvidencePanel.tsx:81 repeats fixed-white styling. These bypass theme-aware neutral surface/border roles.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface and border variables/Card contract. Keep semantic badge and warning meanings without glow, gradients or saturation escalation.

architectureIssues.detail: The variable latest is items[0] of the current server page, and standalone evidence carries no version/generated-at identity. Current service returns at most one item, so multi-row evidence mismatch is a dormant presentation risk, not a verified current production history bug.
architectureIssues.fix: Clearly associate evidence with the shown decision's version/time; preserve backend ordering and all returned evidence. Do not invent a historical latest record or expand backend capabilities in a cosmetic change.

architectureIssues.detail: Local page state has no vehicle-change reset. If a future/history response exposes total>10, switching vehicle on page N retains the prior offset; Pagination clamps display locally but does not correct caller state. Current one-result service does not expose this transition through the production paginator.
architectureIssues.fix: If pagination becomes reachable, reset/clamp the caller-owned page on scope change without changing the existing query key or workspace selection.

order: Align EvidencePanel trust state before aesthetic adoption.
Replace fixed-white surfaces and localize display enum labels.
Exercise narrow widths/themes/state transitions centrally; keep dormant multi-row risks explicit.
priority.rationale: No deployment action, SI corruption or endpoint mismatch found in the inspected source. Evidence availability language currently overstates what an unresolved source knows.

Existing quality/evidence/limitations/unsupported props remain intact.
usedBy: Other existing EvidencePanel callers require owner-led compatibility review; not individually audited here.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse existing neutral surface/border roles; known quality-status display label mapping with safe fallback, preserving enum and semantic badge variants.

found: Local fixed-white cards compete with existing shared surface roles.
notFoundInInspectedPage: No alternate router, query store, physical-unit helper, range picker, vehicle picker, deployment controller or chart library.

preservation.sourceHashScope: Exact raw bytes of root page web\src\features\advanced-intelligence\pages\FirmwareCanaryPage.tsx, not a dependency aggregate.

sections.name: Decision support, not deployment control warning
Target regression / Peer regression / Matched excess / Decision generated
Explicitly unsupported: causality and deployment commands

actions: Shared header vehicle selection with existing URL/store precedence.
Decision retry/refresh from existing source adapter.
Conditional Pagination when total>10: first/previous/current/next/last and direct jump through shared primitive.
No install, hold, rollback, export or firmware mutation action in this page.
dataBehavior: PAGE_SIZE=10, limit and offset semantics, enablement, query key scope and cancellation.
Every returned item/version/decision, all three percentage metrics including zero/null distinction, generated timestamp and insufficient-versus-supported rationale.
First returned item's quality status, sample count, coverage, observation bounds, reasons, evidence ordering/source/summary/sample count/time and limitations.
Explicitly unsupported causality/deployment statements even without evidence.
Percentages remain raw dimensionless source percentages; timestamps remain source UTC strings, currently rendered by shared browser-default date formatter.
No second workspace selector; no current date-range contract or date-bound endpoint capability inferred.
Persistent shells, loading/fatal/retained-source behavior, safe null arrays and existing i18n keys.
